witness_provenance.tool: orbit-fold, 1M trials per fold, NERSC Perlmutter CPU

provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^280 - 1 with a(x) = x^85 + x^128 + x^179 + x^199 + x^229 + x^266 + x^272, b(x) = x^45 + x^77 + x^142 + x^232 + x^244 + x^256 + x^278; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T].
provenance.notes: Found by a randomized sweep over sparse polynomial pairs, screened against the live board before any expensive work. Checked for single-block logicals via the ideal generated by (x^m - 1)/gcd(a, x^m - 1) before the distance was believed. Distance revision 2026-10-09 (Perlmutter refutation campaign, witnesses by @vprusso): X side 64 -> 56 (orbit-fold search (verify/heuristic_distance.orbit_fold_refute, PR #2902), 1,000,000 trials per folded code, seed 101).
